rows.text: Hundreds of Amber Eras ago, the Kolchis considered devouring others as a sign of great respect. When a baby was born, the entire Kalsasian community would mobilize to care for it. And for their deceased members, the Lapispeakers would craft a special information flake as a burial offering... These beautiful virtues are gradually disappearing with the progression of time. The pessimists of the Garden of Recollection proposed that universal morality should be preserved through emergency measures. However, which virtues are truly worth preserving still seems to be up for debate.
